title: Transit Allowed after a Recent Inspection of a Keyturn Vehicle Listing
content:
A vehicle recently inspected is allowed transit miles against the reported stretch, and how much turns on the interval that inspection granted.

1. A vehicle whose most recent completed inspection is dated within 7 calendar days of the handling date and granted an interval of 5000 miles or more is allowed 40 miles of inspection transit against the reported stretch.

2. A vehicle whose most recent completed inspection is dated within 7 calendar days and granted an interval below 5000 miles is allowed 20 miles.

3. Any other vehicle is allowed none on this ground, an allowance of 0 miles.

### Points of judgement on a Keyturn Vehicle Listing

*The dating gate.* Both of the first two clauses need the most recent completed inspection to be dated within 7 calendar days of the handling date. An inspection dated exactly 7 calendar days before it is within the window; one dated 8 calendar days before it falls to the third clause whatever interval it granted.

*The interval that inspection granted.* Where the dating gate is met, the split is at 5000 miles: an interval of exactly 5000 miles allows 40 miles, and one of 4999 miles allows 20 miles.
